verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented bulk data export, account-wide export, or open-format download for leaving incident.io. A REST API with an OpenAPI spec, an MCP server and webhooks are developer building blocks, not an export capability. Syncing follow-ups to GitHub, GitLab or Asana and streaming audit logs to Datadog are adjacent features that cover only narrow data subsets.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
